[8CWelcome to NetHack![16C( description of version 3.6 )

[8CNetHack is a Dungeons and Dragons like game where you (the adventurer)
descend into the depths of the dungeon in search of the Amulet of Yendor,
reputed to be hidden somewhere below the twentieth level.  You begin your
adventure with a pet that can help you in many ways, and can be trained
to do all sorts of things.  On the way you will find useful (or useless)
items, quite possibly with magic properties, and assorted monsters.  You can
attack a monster by trying to move onto the space a monster is on (but often
it is much wiser to leave it alone).

[8CUnlike most adventure games, which give you a verbal description of
your location, NetHack gives you a visual image of the dungeon level you are
on.

[8CNetHack uses the following symbols:

[8C- and |  The walls of a room, possibly also open doors or a grave.
[8C.[8CThe floor of a room or a doorway.
[8C#[8CA corridor, or iron bars, or a tree, or possibly a kitchen
[17Csink (if your dungeon has sinks), or a drawbridge.
[8C>[8CStairs down: a way to the next level.
[8C<[8CStairs up: a way to the previous level.
--More--

[8C@[8CYou (usually), or another human.
[8C)[8CA weapon of some sort.
[8C[[8CA suit or piece of armor.
[8C%[8CSomething edible (not necessarily healthy).
[8C/[8CA wand.
[8C=[8CA ring.
[8C?[8CA scroll.
[8C![8CA potion.
[8C([8CSome other useful object (pick-axe, key, lamp...)
[8C$[8CA pile of gold.
[8C*[8CA gem or rock (possibly valuable, possibly worthless).
[8C+[8CA closed door, or a spellbook containing a spell
[17Cyou can learn.
[8C^[8CA trap (once you detect it).
[8C"[8CAn amulet, or a spider web.
[8C0[8CAn iron ball.
[8C_[8CAn altar, or an iron chain.
[8C{[8CA fountain.
[8C}[8CA pool of water or moat or a pool of lava.
[8C\[8CAn opulent throne.
[8C`[8CA boulder or statue.
[8CA to Z, a to z, and several others:  Monsters.
[8CI[8CInvisible or unseen monster's last known location
--More--
